description: Move a CONFIRMED session to another time with the same psychologist. Allowed once per session, at no charge, when the session is 24 hours or more away. A second change counts as a cancellation and anything inside 24 hours carries the full fee, so those go to ElloMind on WhatsApp. Check the new time with check_availability (same psychologist) first. The Meet link stays the same and everyone is emailed.
name: reschedule_booking
title: Move a confirmed session
